svg.title: Task delivery
svg.desc: The lead checks acceptance and all required work before choosing the result path. Each delivery subprocess requires its own artifact and provider evidence; the Review destination table preserves every configured target.

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 2. Which outcome is supported by evidence?

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 3. Worker merges; tool confirms In Dev

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 4. Tool verifies staging and confirms In Staging

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 5. Tool verifies production and confirms Done

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 7. Human chooses the next status after review

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 8. Tool reports the actual outcome to the lead
